findings.description: The bucket is documented as public with no bucket policy or public access block restricting access, exposing its contents (including a customer master data file) to unauthenticated/anonymous access.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, so objects stored in this bucket (including sensitive customer data) are stored unencrypted at rest.
A customer master data file (customer-master.xlsx) is uploaded to a bucket that is public and unencrypted, directly exposing sensitive customer information to unauthorized access.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined for this financials bucket, leaving potentially sensitive financial data unencrypted at rest.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined for this bucket, leaving operational data unencrypted at rest.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined for this bucket, leaving data science datasets unencrypted at rest.
